## Corcovado and Tijuca Rainforest

This wonderful excursion is a must for discovering Rio's sights. Travel through Tijuca Rainforest to Corcovado, a name meaning "hunchback" that aptly describes the mountain's shape. You will arrive at the foot of the impressive Christ the Redeemer (Cristo Redentor), the symbol of Rio de Janeiro. The statue itself stands 30 meters high, excluding its seven-meter pedestal.

From Corcovado, enjoy magnificent views of Rio de Janeiro! See the white-sand beaches of Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon, Rodrigo de Freitas Lagoon and the Botanical Garden.

From the Dona Marta viewpoint, you can see Maracanã Stadium, Guanabara Bay and Sugarloaf Mountain.

Return to the hotel by jeep.

Group tour. Minimum of 2 participants. Departure times: 09:00 and 14:00. Duration: 3 hours.

The name Monteverde means "green mountain" in Spanish. The route winds through mountain cloud forest to the Viento Fresco Waterfalls.

At Victor Alvarez's farm, you can follow forest trails, swim near five waterfalls, explore caves or choose a horseback ride.

The tour concludes with a traditional lunch at the complex's restaurant.

## Discover Local Craft Beer

We will arrange a tasting of 3 La Rana Dorada beers for your group. During the hour-long session, a host will introduce the styles, aromas, flavors and distinctive features of each beer.

On a corporate trip to Panama, we can pair this tasting with a day in Gamboa and a sightseeing tour of the capital. We will arrange a coach transfer for the group and calculate its cost as part of the full program. We will agree on the venue, language and tasting time with you when you book.
